and that, in the meantime, we may see from on high, as in mirror, the punishment prepared for the unbelieving, so that we may not follow their example nor implicate ourselves in their vices, but separate ourselves from them, that, being devoted to thee, we may fight under the banner of thine only-begotten Son, until he shall gather us into his celestial kingdom. — Amen.<div eID="gen64888" type="x-p"/><div eID="gen64886"/><div eID="gen64824"/> <div sID="gen64889"/> <div sID="gen64890" type="x-p"/>A TRANSLATION OF<div eID="gen64890" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64891" type="x-p"/>CALVIN’S VERSION OF<div eID="gen64891" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64892" type="x-p"/>JEREMIAH<div eID="gen64892" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64893" type="x-p"/>CHAPTERS 30—47<div eID="gen64893" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64894"/> <div sID="gen64895" type="x-p"/>CHAPTER 30<div eID="gen64895" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64896" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">1 </hi>The word which came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying, —<div eID="gen64896" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64897" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">2 </hi>Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, saying, — Write thee all the words which I have spoken to thee in a book;<div eID="gen64897" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64898" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">3</hi> For, be- hold, the days are coming, saith Jehovah, when I shall restore the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith Jehovah; and I will restore them to the land which I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.<div eID="gen64898" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64899" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">4 </hi>Even these are the words which Jehovah hath spoken of Israel and Judah, —<div eID="gen64899" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64900" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">5 </hi>Surely thus saith Jehovah, — A voice of trembling have we heard, Of fear and not of peace.<div eID="gen64900" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64901" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">6 </hi>Ask and see, can a male bring forth? Why have I seen all men With their hands on their loins as a woman in travail? Turned also are all faces into paleness.<div eID="gen64901" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64902" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">7 </hi>Alas! for great that day, none like it, Even a time of distress to Jacob; Yet from it shall he be saved:<div eID="gen64902" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64903" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">8 </hi>And it shall be in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, <hi type="italic">That </hi>I will break the yoke from thy neck, And thy bands will I burst asunder, And no more force thee to serve shall strangers;<div eID="gen64903" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64904" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">9 </hi>But serve shall they Jehovah their God, And David their king, whom I will raise up for them.<div eID="gen64904" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64905" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">10 </hi>And thou Jacob my servant, fear not, saith Jehovah, And be not thou, Israel, afraid; For behold I will save thee from far, And thy seed from the land of their captivity, And dwell shall Jacob, and rest, and be secure, And none shall terrify him:<div eID="gen64905" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64906" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">11 </hi>For I <hi type="italic">shall be </hi>with thee, saith Jehovah, to save thee; For I will make an end of all the nations, Among whom I shall scatter thee; Yet of thee I will not make an end: But I will chastise thee in moderation, And I will not wholly cut thee off.<div eID="gen64906" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64907" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">12 </hi>For thus saith Jehovah, Grievous thy bruise, desperate thy wound!<div eID="gen64907" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64908" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">13 </hi>No one undertakes thy cause; For a cure, medicines and healing thou hast not.<div eID="gen64908" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64909" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">14 </hi>All thy friends forget thee, they ask not for thee; For with the stroke of an enemy have I struck thee, With the chastisement of the cruel, On account of the multitude of thine iniquity, Because prevailed have thy sins.<div eID="gen64909" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen64910" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">15 </hi>Why criest thou because of thy bruise?
